name: whisper.cpp
notable_features: Plain C/C++ implementation with no dependencies beyond ggml
Apple Silicon first-class citizen with Metal and Core ML (ANE) support
Integer quantization (Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, etc.) for reduced memory and faster inference
Vulkan support for cross-vendor GPU coverage (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA)
Voice Activity Detection (VAD) via Silero VAD
Supports all Whisper variants: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v1/v2/v3, large-v3-turbo
Also supports NVIDIA Parakeet TDT models (src/parakeet.cpp)
hardware_caveats: NVIDIA: requires CUDA 11+ for GPU support; compute capability 5.0+
AMD: ROCm/HIP support requires ROCm 5.6+; Vulkan is the more portable AMD path
Core ML (ANE) encoder support is Apple Silicon only and requires macOS 14+
Quantization can reduce accuracy; Q5_0 is the default for a reason
best_for: Cross-platform Whisper inference from a single binary
Edge and mobile deployment (iOS, Android, WASM)
Scenarios where Python/PyTorch is not available or desired
avoid_for: Production multi-tenant serving with continuous batching
Scenarios requiring the latest Whisper features or fine-tuned models
Non-Whisper architectures (use vLLM or SGLang instead)
notes: whisper.cpp is a from-scratch C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper using the ggml tensor library. It is NOT a wrapper around PyTorch. The project is actively maintained with regular releases. It supports all Whisper variants and has recently added Parakeet TDT support. The Vulkan backend provides the widest GPU coverage. Core ML support on Apple Silicon can provide >3x speedup over CPU-only encoder inference. ||| MAINTENANCE (dated fact, GitHub API, 2026-10-04): last commit 2026-10-02 (0.1 months before this record), latest release v1.9.4 published 2026-09-11, 1043 contributors (distinct committers including anonymous), open_issues_count 350 (issues PLUS pull requests - see [[ev-github-open-issues-count-includes-pull-requests]]), not archived, 54127 stars.
